assumptions.classification: exact constructor reparameterization using distributivity; widened u64 arithmetic cannot wrap for these operand widths

coverage.valid_reparameterization: For every constructor-admitted layout and valid range, frame_count=end-start and tail=total-end produce the constructive tuple. data_len=total*block_align equals the three segment sum by integer distributivity. Conversely every constructed tuple is valid and constructor-admitted. No representative-value sampling or concrete fixture narrowing.
coverage.frame_index_domain: Because valid end<=total_frames and total_frames is derived from u32 data_len/u16 nonzero block_align, end<=u32::MAX. Therefore u64-to-u32 conversion after validation is exact, not narrowing.
coverage.complement: Valid and invalid predicates are exact Boolean complements over the same full u64 start/end domain.
